transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

For the past three weeks, I've been feeling completely emotionally numb, as if my mind is just empty. I can't seem to feel any happiness or positive emotions at all, no matter what happens. It's like my ability to feel anything good has been completely blocked.
Have you ever had periods lasting several days or more where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, excited, or needed much less sleep than usual?
No, I've never had periods like that. I haven't ever felt unusually energetic, excited, or felt like I needed less sleep. It has really just been this constant feeling of being empty and numb.
During this time, have you experienced anything unusual, like hearing voices when no one is around, or feeling like people are plotting against you?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that at all. I don't hear any strange voices, and I've never felt like people are plotting against me.
Was there a specific stressful event or major change in your life that happened around the time these feelings started?

I honestly can't think of any specific stressful event or major life change that triggered these feelings. They just seemed to start out of nowhere about three weeks ago, and they've been constant ever since.
How has your sleep been over these past few weeks, and have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking in energy?
My sleep has actually been relatively normal over the past few weeks. I also haven't been feeling unusually tired or lacking in energy.
Have you found it harder to concentrate on things, like reading or watching TV, or have you had trouble making decisions lately?

I haven't really noticed any major issues with my concentration or making decisions lately. My main struggles have just been feeling completely emotionally numb and getting very easily startled by things.
You mentioned being easily startled and feeling emotionally numb. Have you ever experienced or witnessed a deeply traumatic, shocking, or life-threatening event in your past?

I can't really think of any deeply traumatic or life-threatening event like that in my past. I'm not sure what could have triggered this, since my main issues right now are just this constant emotional numbness and being so easily startled by everything.
Over the past few weeks or months, have you been experiencing persistent, excessive worry or anxiety about everyday things that you find difficult to control?

No, I haven't really been experiencing that kind of persistent, uncontrollable worry about everyday things. I mostly just feel completely emotionally numb and find myself getting very easily startled by things around me.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently, or have you been feeling unusually guilty or worthless?
No, my appetite and weight have remained completely normal. I also haven't been feeling unusually guilty or worthless.
Have you had any thoughts of death, hurting yourself, or that life isn't worth living lately?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of death or hurting myself at all. I have never felt like life isn't worth living, even though I've been struggling so much with this numbness.
